# Point Cloud Visuals

> Done-for-you cinematic visual packages built from LiDAR, photogrammetry, and 3D scan data, for surveying and reality capture studios that have strong datasets but weak presentation.

Point Cloud Visuals (PCV) is a Sydney-based studio founded in 2024 by Edwin Boer, named Best Point Cloud Visualisation Specialist in Australia by APAC Insider (2026) and winner of the 2025 3Dise Visualization Contest. The studio turns scan datasets into cinematic visual packages used for tenders, boardroom pitches, sales decks, LinkedIn content, and trade-show booth walls. Every dataset is reviewed personally before quoting.

## What we do

- Cinematic flythroughs from LiDAR and photogrammetry datasets
- Multi-channel visual packages (one dataset → 5-10 channel deliverables)
- Recurring content pipelines for ongoing scan work
- BIM, CAD, and DTM overlays
- Heritage, marine, aerial, infrastructure, and scan-to-BIM
- Industry speaking, studio consulting (adjacent work)

## Who it's for

- Reality capture studios serving developers, architects, councils, and asset owners
- Surveying firms competing on tenders where presentation moves the win rate
- AEC professionals, infrastructure clients, heritage organisations
- Studios scanning regularly that need a recurring visual partner

## Who it isn't for

- DIY hobbyists looking for tutorials
- Price-only shoppers chasing Matterport-tier visuals
- Buyers expecting same-day turnaround on complex datasets
- Studios unwilling to share dataset access for scoping

## Accepted formats

Point clouds: E57, LAS, LAZ, RCP, RCS, PTS, PLY.
Meshes and models: OBJ, FBX, DWG, DXF, RVT, PLN, IFC, Gaussian Splat.
Overlays from: Revit, ArchiCAD, Rhino, SketchUp.
Hardware pipelines: Leica, FARO, Trimble, Xgrids, Emesent, NavVis, photogrammetry.

## Where we work

Based in Sydney, Australia. Active engagements across the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, Australia, and the UAE. Time zones are not a blocker; dataset access is all that's needed.

## Turnaround

3-6 business days per project. Priority turnaround (48-72 hours) available as an add-on at +35% of base. Recurring partners are first in the priority queue.

## Engagement formats (fixed-fee, quoted on dataset review)

- **Single project**. One 60-180 sec flythrough, up to 5 review rounds included (9 in 10 projects need no more than two), social cuts, 8 hero stills, source-archive ZIP. 3-6 day turnaround.
- **Quarterly pipeline**, quarterly billing. One full project per quarter plus three monthly cuts, retained creative direction, priority production lane, annual content roadmap.
- **Annual partner**, 12-month term. 1-3 full projects per quarter plus monthly cuts, first-in-queue turnaround, trade-show retainer, co-branded sales assets.

Add-ons: data preparation; priority turnaround; on-site capture coordination; tender extract pack; sales-team briefing; engineered VO; translation.

Written proposal within 24 hours of receiving the data.

## Results

- 8 out of 10 studios return for a second project
- ~70% of studios on retainer by project 3
- $50-100K+ in hardware sales supported per LiDAR system, sold off booths and launches running our visuals, from Geo Week to INTERGEO, plus the services sold with them
- One dataset typically deploys across 5-10 channels
- ~35% lower per-asset cost on a Tier-02 pipeline vs single-project pricing

## Authorship & expertise

All visual work is led by Edwin Boer, who spent six years on the client's side of the scan (EU-registered, OAR Romania, since 2020) and has deep experience in reality capture workflows. The studio is a small, steadily growing team, every dataset is reviewed personally before quoting. Primary toolset is Nubigon, Unreal Engine, DaVinci Resolve, Recap, Revit, ArchiCAD, and Twinmotion. No production work is subcontracted. Recognition includes Winner of the 2025 3Dise Visualization Contest and APAC Insider's Best Point Cloud Visualisation Specialist in Australia (2026).

## Notable projects (selected)

- **Phoenix LiDAR Systems · GeoWeek 2026**, Hero reel for the booth wall. ~20× ROI on visual cost from hardware sales lift. US.
- **Digital Dry Dock**, Three audience-segmented hull films replaced a static PDF brochure as the primary sales tool. UK.
- **Joe Sparrow Media**, Cinematic boardroom presentation won a multi-year reality capture contract with a major developer. AU.
- **Quiddity Engineering**, Multi-department flythrough aligned office and field teams on infrastructure work. US.
- **Archilink Surveys**, Heritage walkthrough + drawing overlay, approved by stakeholders without notes. UK.
- **My Digital Buildings**, Monthly content pipeline producing 2× qualified inbound growth from organic LinkedIn. EU.
